title: How do the Centre and states share money? The Finance Commission explained
seoTitle: Finance Commission of India: How Tax Is Shared With States
seoDescription: The Finance Commission gives states 41% of the divisible pool of central taxes. See the 16th FC formula, weights, state shares and why states disagree.
excerpt: Why 41% of central taxes works out to about 35% for states, the six-part formula that decides each state's slice, the grants that changed, and the rich-versus-poor states debate.
